title: Admin Pickaxe
body:
Unobtainable
The following content is not obtainable by any means.

Reason: This item is exclusive to Developers.

"MINING AWAY"

Description

The Admin Pickaxe is an admin tool obtainable only by using a Spawn Menu. Like the name implies, it's a tool used for ease of testing for mining. It has maxed out stats, capable of one-shotting most ore veins in the game, having no charge and 50 studs of range.

Appearance

The Admin Pickaxe is a medium sized pick with a glossy pink headpiece and pearly white handle. Headpiece is pink in color with the default legacy foil material applied to it. Handle is colored white, using the default legacy wood material.

It's model appears to derived from the Rusty Pickaxe, minus the improvised grip.

Trivia

  • Early version of Admin Pickaxe used to have a decal of the internet meme "Giga Chad" plastered over it's headpiece. DevShurikeno used to have a special variant of the Admin Axe, with a decal of...Twitch streamer XQC morphed into a Pepe the frog holding a pink heart plastered over it's headpiece.
  • Current design of Admin Pickaxe uses the design first introduced in older Oaklands iteration - Oaklands Legacy.
  • It's stats are not representitive of it's actual power, as the description was copied over from Admin Axe.
  • It's description is a reference to a classic youtube video "MINE DIAMONDS | miNECRAFT PARODY OF TAKE ON ME".
  • The admin pickaxe as well as other admin tools are publicly usable in "Oaklands 100 Players", however this game is rarely unlocked by the developers.
